component.name: kmd
component.summary: Beautiful Markdown previews in the terminal

description.p: kmd renders Markdown documents as rich, colorful previews directly in your terminal. It is a single small binary without dependencies that starts in a few milliseconds.

ul.li: Full CommonMark 0.31.2 and GitHub Flavored Markdown support
Syntax highlighting for more than 20 languages
Mermaid and Graphviz diagrams drawn with Unicode box characters
LaTeX math formulas rendered with Unicode
Thirteen bundled color themes and fully customizable themes
Live preview mode, table of contents and HTML export

description.p: Full CommonMark and GFM, diagrams, math, inline images, themes.
